{
  "summary": "Added support for parsing and saving [REVIEW_RESPONSE] markers from AI output, enabling AI to respond to Inter-Review feedback programmatically. The feature is implemented consistently across TraeReflect class and CLI.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Marker pattern design", "reminder": "When adding new marker types (LEARN, PROMPT_UPDATE, ISSUE, REVIEW_RESPONSE), always validate UUIDs before database operations to prevent SQL errors"},
    {"topic": "Regex patterns", "reminder": "Use non-greedy matchers (.+?) with lookahead (?=\\[|$) to handle multiple markers in text - prevents over-matching"},
    {"topic": "Error handling", "reminder": "TraeReflect.saveReviewResponse() has try/catch with re-throw - consider whether CLI needs similar error handling for production use"},
    {"topic": "Consistency", "reminder": "When implementing feature in multiple places (TraeReflect.ts + CLI), ensure validation logic is consistent - CLI also validates UUID at line 1556"},
    {"topic": "TypeScript", "reminder": "Always export new interfaces from index.ts when they're part of public API (done correctly here with TraeReviewResponseMarker)"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "location": "src/cli/index.ts:1550-1565",
      "description": "No try/catch around database query - if respond_to_inter_review fails, CLI will crash without helpful error",
      "recommendation": "Wrap in try/catch like TraeReflect does, or at minimum log the error before re-throwing"
    },
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "location": "trae_alone/src/TraeReflect.ts:164",
      "description": "split(',') on accepted suggestions could break if suggestion contains comma - no escaping mechanism",
      "recommendation": "Consider using a different delimiter or escaping mechanism for accepted suggestions"
    }
  ],
  "praise": [
    "Clean interface design with proper TypeScript typing",
    "Consistent pattern with existing markers (LEARN, PROMPT_UPDATE, ISSUE)",
    "UUID validation before database call prevents invalid data",
    "Good help text addition showing users how to use the new marker",
    "Proper total calculation in TraeReflectResult including reviewResponses"
  ],
  "testCoverage": "No new tests added for parseReviewResponseMarkers or the new functionality",
  "suggestions": [
    "Add unit tests for parseReviewResponseMarkers to verify regex parsing",
    "Consider adding test for saveReviewResponse with invalid UUID",
    "Add integration test for CLI marker parsing"
  ],
  "overallScore": 88,
  "codeQualityScore": 90,
  "testCoverageScore": 70,
  "documentationScore": 95
}
